description: Gas Natural is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Comisión Nacional de Energía (CNE). Información estadística referente al sector Gas Natural. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Comisión Nacional de Energía (CNE). Its tags are explotación hidrocarburos, fuente energía no renovable, industria gas, precio, precio gasolina. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
